name: io.devicechain.demo-hud
description: The story HUD the DeviceChain Unity demos share: a top strip, a top-centre caption box that fades between lines, a chain card that builds cause and effect one recorded step at a time, teardrop alarm pins sized in screen space, a cleared tick and a three-level end card. The timing and layout rules are engine-free and tested; the uGUI views draw them with no image or font assets.
